comments.body: This return-code claim is wrong for the decoder being modeled: when input runs out before EOB, GET_BITS in upstream/decompress.c:54 returns BZ_OK so BZ2_decompress can resume with more input. BZ_UNEXPECTED_EOF is produced by higher-level wrappers (for example bzlib.c:1339-1345). decode returns none for this case, so the statements at lines 24 and 137 that none corresponds exactly to BZ_DATA_ERROR are false. State an explicit domain requiring an EOB, or distinguish incomplete input from BZ_DATA_ERROR in the result and documentation.

The cited run-place-value guard is at upstream/decompress.c:396, not line 392. The final origPtr rejection cited at line 35 is at decompress.c:497-498. Please update these exact source references so the failure claims are traceable.

last.summary: The symbol map, MTF steps, RUNA/RUNB encoding, run-digit bound, and block-length checks match the cited C paths. Please correct the decoder failure contract for input ending before EOB and the affected return-code claim. The source citations for the run guard and final origPtr check also point to the wrong lines. I could not run verify.sh because lake is unavailable in this environment.
